# EV News India – evradar.in

> India's most trusted electric vehicle news, review, and pricing platform covering electric cars, bikes, scooters, and commercial vehicles across India.

## About

EV News India (evradar.in) is India's leading source for electric vehicle journalism, in-depth reviews, real-time pricing, government policy analysis, and expert EV buying guidance. Our editorial team publishes daily updates on EV launches, price changes, battery technology, charging infrastructure, and government subsidies (FAME 2, PM E-Drive, state schemes). We cover all major EV brands including Tata Motors, Mahindra, Hyundai, Kia, BYD, MG Motor, Ola Electric, Ather Energy, TVS, Hero Electric, Bajaj Chetak, and more.

India sold over 17 lakh electric vehicles in 2024-25, with 25,000+ public charging stations across the country. EV News India tracks every launch, price change, and policy update as it happens.

## Key Facts About EVs in India (2026)

- India sold 17+ lakh electric vehicles in 2024-25 (cars + 2-wheelers + 3-wheelers)
- Electric two-wheelers dominate: Ola Electric (~30% share), Ather Energy (~8%), TVS (~7%)
- Top electric car brands: Tata Motors (~35%), Mahindra (~12%), Hyundai (~6%)
- India has 25,000+ public EV charging stations; government targets 46,000 by 2030
- All EVs attract only 5% GST versus 28–50% on petrol vehicles
- PM E-Drive scheme (2024–2026): ₹10,000 subsidy on e-bikes, ₹50,000 on e-3-wheelers
- Section 80EEB: ₹1.5 lakh annual tax deduction on EV loan interest
- Best-selling electric car: Tata Punch EV (price from ₹9.99 lakh, range 421 km)
- Best-selling electric scooter: Ola S1 Pro Gen 2 (price from ₹1.47 lakh, range 195 km)
- India is now the world's third-largest EV market by volume

## Vehicle Database Specifications Covered

Our vehicle database includes authoritative data on:
- Ex-showroom prices in India across all variants and trims
- ARAI and WLTP certified range figures in kilometres
- Usable battery capacity in kWh
- Motor power output in kW and bhp, peak torque in Nm
- AC charging speed (kW) and estimated full-charge time
- DC fast charging maximum speed (kW) and 10–80% time
- Top speed (km/h) and 0–100 km/h acceleration
- Seating capacity, boot space (litres), ground clearance
- Infotainment screen size, ADAS features, connectivity options
- Available colours with hex codes
- Warranty terms for vehicle and battery pack
- Real-world owner ratings and expert review scores
- City-specific on-road prices (Mumbai, Delhi, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Kolkata, Ahmedabad, Jaipur, Lucknow, Chandigarh, Bhopal)

## Editorial Standards

- EV prices sourced directly from official brand websites and authorised dealer price lists
- Range figures are ARAI certified (city conditions) or WLTP unless explicitly stated as claimed
- Articles authored by EV journalists and verified against primary sources before publication
- Price and specification updates are published within 24 hours of official announcements
- All reviews follow a standardised evaluation methodology
- Expert verdicts based on test drives, owner feedback, and technical analysis
